result.reason: With over $622 billion in AUM, SPY is essentially the Elvis of ETFs — everyone owns it and it never really goes out of style. A 1.05% yield won't make you rich overnight, but its Large Blend category and unmatched liquidity make it the sensible anchor for any portfolio that prefers not to gamble on meme stocks.
